title: Polymarket Review 2026: Prediction Market or Hype?
description:
Is Polymarket worth using in 2026, or is it too risky for regular investors? In this honest walkthrough, we take a new visitor's look at Polymarket, the platform calling itself the world's largest prediction market. We test its claims, evaluate what kinds of assets you can actually trade, and break down the crucial differences between event contracts and traditional brokerage accounts.

We check for standard investing safeguards like FINRA and SIPC membership, examine the availability of retirement accounts like IRAs, look for clear fee structures and account minimums, and review the geo-restrictions currently impacting United States users. If you are browsing from the US, you will notice direct trading is restricted on the main site and routed toward polymarket.us or view-only mode.

Whether you are curious about betting on interest rate decisions, global elections, or crypto price movements, find out who this platform actually makes sense for and who should stick with standard retail brokers.
